suppress.notes: file name: kotlinx-coroutines-play-services-1.10.2.jar False positive: dependency-check incorrectly associates these CVEs with this library
file name: play-services-basement-18.3.0.jar False positive: these CVEs relate to Google Play Store app, not the client library
file name: gson-2.13.2.jar False positive: CVE-2025-53864 is a vulnerability in Nimbus JOSE+JWT, not Gson. NVD explicitly states "this is independent of the Gson 2.11"
file name: ktlint-cli-reporter-checkstyle-1.7.1.jar False positive: dependency-check incorrectly associates checkstyle CVEs with ktlint
file name: collection-ktx-1.4.2.jar False positive: dependency-check incorrectly identifies this Android library as Apache Beam/Flink/Spark

file name: analysis-markdown, dokka-base, dokka-core, analysis-kotlin-descriptors (2.0.0) CVE-2020-29582 is a Kotlin temp-file permissions issue incorrectly attributed to Dokka build-tooling artifacts.
file name: browser-1.4.0.aar CVE-2008-7298 is a 2008 CVE for the old AOSP "Android Browser" app, incorrectly matched against the modern androidx.browser library.
file name: kotlin-android-extensions-runtime / kotlin-parcelize-runtime CVE-2025-29903 relates to Kotlin Multiplatform Gradle tooling, not these Android runtime libraries.

file name: kotlin-stdlib*.jar, kotlin-reflect*.jar CVE-2020-29582 affects only Kotlin < 1.4.21 (temp file permissions in the stdlib io helpers); older stdlib versions that appear here are transitive and are resolved to newer versions at runtime.

CVE-2026-53914 is CPE-matched (cpe:jetbrains:kotlin) against every org.jetbrains.kotlin artifact regardless of version, including old transitive 1.6-1.9 stdlib/reflect jars. No patched Kotlin release is available yet. Temporary stopgap approved for PEMC-1854 / MR !62; revisit by 2026-12-31 (Kotlin upgrade).

file name: grpc-*-1.57.2.jar CVE-2023-44487 (HTTP/2 Rapid Reset). Dependency-check matches the generic cpe:grpc:grpc without a version range. grpc-java 1.57.2 is itself a patched release for Rapid Reset, and the underlying Netty is forced to 4.1.130.Final in exampleapp/build.gradle, so the issue is already fixed. Short-dated for re-verification.

file name: opentelemetry-api-1.49.0.jar, opentelemetry-context-1.49.0.jar CVE-2026-54285: no fixed version could be verified (no Maven Central access from this tooling). Transitive dependency of the Sudo Platform SDK; short-dated so it is revisited. Re-check for a patched release.

file name: netty-*-4.1.130.Final.jar (buffer, codec, common, handler, handler-proxy, resolver, transport, transport-native-unix-common) 2026 Netty advisories reported against 4.1.130.Final (the latest 4.1.x already forced in build.gradle). No fixed version could be verified as published/compatible. Netty is a transitive dependency of the Sudo Platform SDK / gRPC and is not used directly by the app. Short-dated so it is revisited when a patched Netty is available.
